fields.name: ShardDataConnection<TConfiguration> RunAsync(ShardBatch) transactional family
fields.contract: For a ShardBatch<TResult> composed of multiple commands, RunAsync executes that batch's commands against this single shard within one transaction and returns the batch's declared TResult. This is the single-shard execution path for a ShardBatch assembled elsewhere in the shard-set API; unlike the Query-based RunAsync overloads, it takes the batch and a cancellation token only, with no separate parameters or shardParameterName argument of its own.
